method: Node tests scan all 22 actual ILDA files with the upstream LaserScanner and exercise LaserShow playback; no browser automation or GPU execution
verified: All 22 actual files scan every point of every frame exactly once before advancing in catalog order and wrapping to the first
Final update stops at the last point without scanning into the next cycle; final displayed frame remains the last frame
Paused playback and hidden page preserve integer and fractional scan progress; point-rate changes never truncate the program
One transition per async load; manual selection starts a fresh full program and continues from its catalog position
Seek, paused retuning, restart and track changes realign completion to the actual upstream scanner
Disabling allows the current program to loop; re-enabling restarts it for complete playback
Single-frame input and fractional-point timing do not cause early completion
completion: Actual scanned point count for the selected track, with final update delta capped at the cycle boundary
browserVerification: Not performed: prior browser security policy rejected page inspection (URL protocol not allowed).
